name: ER Modelling and Chen Notation
learning_objective: Construct an entity-relationship diagram using Chen notation, correctly distinguishing entities, relationships, attributes, and cardinality.

name: Relational Model, Keys, Integrity Constraints, and Relationships
learning_objective: Describe the relational model's structure of relations, tuples, and domains, and apply entity and referential integrity constraints.

name: Relational Algebra and Introductory Relational Calculus
learning_objective: Apply the selection and projection operators of relational algebra to express a simple query.

name: SQL Querying and Joins
learning_objective: Write and interpret SQL SELECT statements, including joins that combine rows from multiple tables.

name: Functional Dependencies and Normalization Through 3NF
learning_objective: Identify functional dependencies in a relation and normalize a schema through third normal form (3NF).

name: Transactions, ACID Properties, Concurrency, and Recoverability
learning_objective: Explain the ACID properties of a database transaction and how concurrency control and recovery preserve them.

name: Indexing and Introductory Query-Performance Concepts
learning_objective: Explain how a B-tree/B+ tree index improves query performance compared to scanning every row.
